Got questions?

Everything shop owners usually ask before we start.

How long does it take?

Starter sites take 3–5 days and Business sites 5–7 days. Premium timelines depend on the scope, and we'll agree on a date before we start.

Do I need to give photos and content?

Photos of your shop, products and your contact details are enough. If you don't have photos, we'll guide you on what to click.

Will it work on mobile phones?

Yes. Every site is built mobile-first because most of your customers will open it on their phone.

Do I need to buy a domain?

A domain like yourshop.in costs around ₹800–1,000 per year. We help you pick and set it up.

Can I ask for changes after it's live?

Yes. Small changes are easy, and Premium includes one month of free support.

How do I pay?

A part upfront to start and the rest when you approve the design. Payment details are shared on WhatsApp.
